carpet.rule.ccuDebugLog.name: ccuDebugLog
carpet.rule.ccuDebugLog.desc: Outputs verbose lifecycle logs of Carpet CCU Addition, for debugging.
carpet.rule.ccuDebugLog.extra.0: Only changes log verbosity; no gameplay effect.
Preloads fake player profiles on server start: registers every name in ccuFakePlayerNames into usercache, so spawning a bot with /player no longer needs a Mojang lookup.
Names that already have a profile keep their UUID and skin; unknown names get a deterministic offline UUID that survives restarts.
Only affects bots spawned afterwards, never online players.
Changing this rule or the name list requires a server restart.
carpet.rule.ccuFakePlayerNames.name: ccuFakePlayerNames
carpet.rule.ccuFakePlayerNames.desc: Comma or space separated fake player names to preload, e.g. bot1,bot2,bot3.
carpet.rule.ccuFakePlayerNames.extra.0: Names must be valid Minecraft usernames: 3-16 chars of letters, digits and underscore. Invalid names are skipped with a warning.
Enables /ccuplayer: run any /player action on a group of fake players. Values: false / true / ops / 0-4, same meaning as commandPlayer.
Usage: /ccuplayer <name prefix|all> <action>, e.g. /ccuplayer bot use continuous, /ccuplayer bot jump, /ccuplayer all stop.
Action syntax is parsed by Carpet's /player command, so every /player action works here too.
carpet.rule.ccuCommandPlayerLoadRange.de: Enables /ccuload: enlarge a single fake player's chunk loading range. Enlarge only - it can never go below the server view distance. Values: false / true / ops / 0-4, same meaning as commandPlayer.
carpet.rule.ccuCommandPlayerLoadRange.ex: Usage: /ccuload <bot name> <radius|default>, e.g. /ccuload bot1 8; default restores the server view distance behaviour.
Bots without a setting load chunks exactly like vanilla. A radius not larger than the server view distance has no extra effect, because vanilla tickets cannot be cancelled.
